nodes.label: PAART Academy Web Application
nodes.rationale: Official server-rendered Remix 3 web application for Puliyangudi Academic & Achievements Resource Trust (est. 22 December 2018, Puliyangudi, Tenkasi District, Tamil Nadu), built following Jchat/apps/store conventions.

nodes.label: Remix 3 SSR & Minimal Islands Architecture
nodes.rationale: Avoids heavy client SPA bundles by using a typed central route map (routes/web.ts), lazy-loaded controllers (app/http/controllers/*), and minimal progressive enhancement islands hydrated via bootstrap/browser.ts.

nodes.label: Composable Router Middleware Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Composes asyncContext, @sdxc/logger, legacy WordPress 301 redirects, PostgreSQL context, compression, CSP and HSTS security headers, rate limiting, formData, @pitlane/assets, SSR render, and PBKDF2/HMAC admin session auth in app/initializers/router.ts.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Data Layer & Seed Data Fallback
nodes.rationale: Uses remix/data-table/postgres (pg) with typed schemas and SQL migrations while read models in app/models/*.ts gracefully fall back to verified PAART Academy seed data when PostgreSQL is unreachable in local previews.
nodes.norm_label: postgresql data layer & seed data fallback

nodes.label: WCAG AA Semantic UI (@sdxc/ui + @sdxc/u)
nodes.rationale: Enforces semantic HTML5 landmarks, WCAG AA contrast tokens in resources/css/theme.css, and zero neumorphism.

nodes.label: SEO, JSON-LD & Legacy WordPress 301 Redirects
nodes.rationale: Preserves live paart.in WordPress URLs (/?page_id=32, 33, 322, and tribe_events) via HTTP 301 redirects alongside Schema.org JSON-LD, /sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, /healthz, and /readyz.

nodes.label: Vite+ (vp) Build & Verification Toolchain
nodes.rationale: Unifies format, type-aware lint, typecheck, Vitest testing, and SSR + client bundling via vite-plus@1.6.0 on Node.js >=24.11.0.

nodes.label: Academic Institution UI Design Constraint
nodes.rationale: Public UI must look like an academic institution and public educational trust using Fraunces, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Noto Sans Tamil, never SaaS landing chrome or neumorphism.

nodes.label: Component-Scoped @sdxc/u & Theme Token Boundary
nodes.rationale: Styles components directly in .tsx using @sdxc/u mix={[...]} and @sdxc/ui primitives so resources/css/theme.css stays restricted to :root/.dark tokens and base resets.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Verification & Graphify Maintenance Gate
nodes.rationale: Mandates validating changes with npx vp check --deny-warnings, npm run typecheck, npm run build, and npm test, and updating graphify-out/ via graphify update .
